sn1.44:1.2: _Patthara_ is probably a “spread” of grass, such as was laid down in rituals.
sn1.44:1.3: If the ocean is counted as the last item, the total is twelve. Thus I take the riddle as fitting all its obstacles into the “abyss of twelve whirlpools” (_dvādasāvaṭṭaṁ pātālaṁ_), which  corresponds with the twelvefold “round” (_vaṭṭa_) of dependent origination.
